/*insertMasterCmClPurchaseTaxsheetIndividualCreation_KEPTAPDT*/
INSERT INTO KEPTAPDT /* 외상매입_세금계산서 */ ( TAX_BILL_NO , KEP_IRS , SITE , DEPT_CODE , STATUS , ISSUE_DATE , CUSTOMER_NAME , IRS_NO , AGENT_CODE , BUYER_CODE
, TOT_SUPP_PRICE , TOT_TAX_PRICE , TOT_AMT , SUPP_PRICE , TAX_PRICE , AMT
, TAX_TYPE , BILL_TYPE , PRINT_DATE , PRINT_USER_ID , PRINT_CNT , PRINT_AVAIL_CNT , REMARK_DESCRIPTION , REMARK_SPECIFICATION , REMARK_QTY , REMARK_PRICE
, ASK_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , SEND_DATE , SEND_TIME , SEND_USER_ID , IF_SEND_DATE , IF_SEND_TIME , IF_SEND_FLAG
, AP_CLOSE_MONTH , AP_CLOSE_REVISION , KEP_IRS_NAME , KEP_CEO_NAME_LOC , KEP_INDUSTRY_TYPE , KEP_BUSINESS_ITEMS , KEP_ADDRESS_LOC , IRS_NAME , CEO_NAME_LOC , INDUSTRY_TYPE , BUSINESS_ITEMS , ADDRESS_LOC , NTS_SEND_FLAG , CONFIRM_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{order_no} , #{KEP_IRS_NO} , 'KA' , #{dept_code} , 'C' , #{issue_date} || #{issue_last_day} , #{agent_name} , #{agent_irs_no} , #{agent_code} , #{BUYER}
, TRUNC(#{tot_supp_price}) , TRUNC(#{tot_tax_price}) , TRUNC(#{tot_supp_price}+#{tot_tax_price}) , TRUNC(#{supp_price}) , TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(#{supp_price})*0.1) , TRUNC(#{supp_price}+(TO_NUMBER(#{supp_price})*0.1))
, DECODE(#{TAX_TYPE}, '12', '23', '21') /* TAX_TYPE (21:과세매입,22:영세매입,23:면세매입) */ , (SELECT BILL_TYPE FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE SYS_TYPE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{agent_code} AND BUSINESS_COND <> 'B') /* BILL_TYPE(10:샌드빌,11:수기) */ , '' , '' , 0 , 1 , SUBSTR(#{item_desc},0,25) , SUBSTR(#{item_desc},0,25) , 1 , TRUNC(#{tot_supp_price})
, '2' /* ASK_TYPE(1:영수2:청구) */ , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , #{st_user_id} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , #{st_user_id} , '' , '' , '' , '' , '' , ''
, #{issue_date} , #{st_close_revision} , (SELECT IRS_NAME FROM KEPTIRSN WHERE SITE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{KEP_COM_CODE} AND IRS_NO = #{KEP_IRS_NO} ) /* KEP_IRS_NAME */ , (SELECT CEO_NAME_LOC FROM KEPTIRSN WHERE SITE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{KEP_COM_CODE} AND IRS_NO = #{KEP_IRS_NO} ) /* KEP_CEO_NAME_LOC */ , (SELECT INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM KEPTIRSN WHERE SITE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{KEP_COM_CODE} AND IRS_NO = #{KEP_IRS_NO} ) /* KEP_INDUSTRY_TYPE */ , (SELECT BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM KEPTIRSN WHERE SITE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{KEP_COM_CODE} AND IRS_NO = #{KEP_IRS_NO} ) /* KEP_BUSINESS_ITEMS */ , (SELECT ADDRESS_LOC FROM KEPTIRSN WHERE SITE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{KEP_COM_CODE} AND IRS_NO = #{KEP_IRS_NO} ) /* KEP_ADDRESS_LOC */ , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE SYS_TYPE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{agent_code} AND BUSINESS_COND <> 'B') /* IRS_NAME */ , (SELECT CEO_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE SYS_TYPE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{agent_code} AND BUSINESS_COND <> 'B') /* CEO_NAME_LOC */ , (SELECT INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE SYS_TYPE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{agent_code} AND BUSINESS_COND <> 'B') /* INDUSTRY_TYPE */ , (SELECT BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE SYS_TYPE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{agent_code} AND BUSINESS_COND <> 'B') /* BUSINESS_ITEMS */ , (SELECT ADDRESS_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE SYS_TYPE = 'KA' AND COM_CODE = #{agent_code} AND BUSINESS_COND <> 'B') /* ADDRESS_LOC */ ,'Y' , 'N' )

/*insertMasterCmClPurchaseTaxsheetIndividualCreation_BillCloseList*/
MERGE INTO BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST A USING ( SELECT (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS LEGACY_USER_ID, #{issue_date} AS BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, 'AP' AS CLOSE_TYPE, #{agent_code} AS AGENT_CODE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = B.LEGACY_USER_ID AND A.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = B.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH AND A.CLOSE_TYPE = B.CLOSE_TYPE AND A.AGENT_CODE = B.AGENT_CODE ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( LEGACY_USER_ID, BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, CLOSE_TYPE, SEQ, KEP_DEPT, BUYER_CODE, AGENT_CODE, CLOSE_CMPL_YN ) VALUES ( (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}), #{issue_date}, 'AP', (SELECT NVL(MAX(SEQ),0) +1 FROM BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST WHERE LEGACY_USER_ID = (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AND BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = #{issue_date} AND CLOSE_TYPE = 'AP' ), #{dept_code}, #{BUYER}, #{agent_code}, 'N' )
